profile.summary: Telos is a private, for-profit residential treatment program in Orem, Utah, for teens and young adults. It offers residential care, partial hospitalization and intensive outpatient programs for depression, anxiety, behavioral challenges and learning differences. Its Telos Academy provides accredited high school classes alongside clinical treatment.
